preconditions.description: The input town is a string.
The town string contains exactly one Pied Piper ('P').

preconditions.expression: all(c in ' O~' for c in town.replace('P', ''))
preconditions.description: Apart from 'P', the town string consists only of spaces, 'O', and '~'.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i, c in enumerate(town) if c == 'O' and ((i < p_idx and town[i+1:i+2] == '~') or (i > p_idx and town[i-1:i] == '~'))) if (p_idx := town.find('P')) != -1 else 0
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of deaf rats: rats ('O') that are to the left of the Piper but moving right ('~O'), or to the right of the Piper but moving left ('O~').
